description: Land Acquisiton - Welata, Kandy and Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired by the government for public purpose. It includes lot numbers, assessments, boundaries, extents, and procedures for interested parties to claim compensation - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters.
